---
title: "Track on Start + Void"
description: "Native Track Worker, qualification commands, cutover packet and Vercel rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Track (`apps/track`) runs as a native TanStack Start app on Vite+ and Void through
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge). The App Router source is
rendered unchanged by the generic RSC adapter; `cloudflare/worker.ts` is the
Worker entry. `next build` (package `build`) remains the Vercel path. Production
publication stays held in `tuturuuu.ci.ts` until a cutover PR admits the app.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | Staging identity `tuturuuu-track-vite-staging` is what `void.config.ts` emits. Deploy the production artifact under `tuturuuu-track` with the deploy-time name override; the config declares no routes |
| Hosts | Root: `track.tuturuuu.com`. Mount: `tuturuuu.com/track`. `TUTURUUU_STAGING_HOSTS` (Worker var, staging only) may add `track.tutur3u.com` or reviewed `workers.dev` hosts. Every other host gets `404` |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (static assets, worker-first, no SPA fallback) |
| Vars (names) | `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`), `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` (set `1` on staging only), `TUTURUUU_STAGING_HOSTS` (staging only) |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. The Worker answers `503` without the last two |
| Build | `bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/track^...`, then `bun run --cwd apps/track build:cloudflare`. Output: `apps/track/dist/server/wrangler.json` and `dist/client` |
| Routing | Attach only `track.tuturuuu.com/*` to the Worker. Do not attach `tuturuuu.com/*` |
| Prior Vercel deployment | Not recorded in the repository. The release owner captures the current production deployment id and DNS record before the flip |

## Rollback

Remove only the new `track.tuturuuu.com/*` Worker route (or restore the captured
DNS record) so the hostname resolves to the captured immutable Vercel deployment.
Never rebuild on the rollback path and never promote the Vercel project as a
whole. Keep the Vercel project and domain until the new Worker has been stable.
Track keeps no state in the Worker, so rollback touches no data.

## Smoke

Anonymous probes after the route is attached:

```bash
node scripts/native-cutover/smoke.mjs --origin https://track.tuturuuu.com --app track --expect native
curl -sI https://track.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info          # 200, no-store
curl -sI https://track.tuturuuu.com/                        # redirect to https://tuturuuu.com/login
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://track.tuturuuu.com/__missing__   # 404, never 5xx
```

Check that every response carries `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, nosnippet`,
`X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `Cache-Control: private, no-store, max-age=0`
(except hashed assets and public files). The rollback smoke is the same command
with `--expect legacy`.

## Qualification

`track-cloudflare.yaml` builds the native output, rejects route-tree drift,
type-checks (`type-check:cloudflare`), seals the emitted Worker with
`scripts/ci/track-native-artifact.py` and runs the emitted-Worker suite in
workerd (`bun run --cwd apps/track test:runtime`), with all egress denied.
Heavy builds run on a remote host, not the local hub.
